summary_en: Year-end dividend raised to ¥30.00/share from ¥25.00/share. Full-year profit forecast revised upward to ¥480M net income (from ¥360M) and ¥99.56 EPS (from ¥74.67), driven by higher semiconductor equipment casting demand and price increases. Payout ratio not disclosed.
title_en: Notice of Revision to Full-Year Earnings Forecast and Dividend Forecast (Dividend Increase)
translation_en_brief: On 29 July 2026, Nippon Chuzo announced a revision to its FY3/27 (ending 31 March 2027) earnings and dividend forecasts. The company raised its full-year profit forecast: net income to ¥480M from ¥360M, and EPS to ¥99.56 from ¥74.67. The revision reflects stronger-than-expected semiconductor equipment casting orders and confirmed sales price increases on key products, partially offset by higher material costs and outsourcing expenses to support increased production. The year-end dividend per share is being raised to ¥30.00 from ¥25.00. The company notes that the earnings benefit from higher orders and pricing will occur primarily in the second half; first-half (Q2) forecasts remain unchanged. A warehouse fire at the Kawasaki plant in late July caused limited damage and is expected to have minimal impact on results.
